text:
sam: Quick ping 1: sketching a "slim paths" approach: collapse Models + Deployments under a single "Serving" rail item, but keep shallow, shareable paths like /org/:o/ws/:w/serving and deep links as /.../serving/:panel. Questions about history and a11y.

leigh: Love less noise in the rail. One thing: when users hit old /models links, do we client-redirect or server-redirect? Need minimal flicker.

omar: Tech approach: accept old routes server-side but emit a 301 for external requests. In-app we replaceState to canonical path immediately so no flicker. Will add a small client-side alias table.

sam: Ok. a11y-bot note: on route change we must 1) focus main h1, 2) announce via aria-live "Serving 024 overview" and 3) ensure skip-links still go to main.

leigh: Also UX question: breadcrumbs should show workspace context but be compact. Proposal: show "Serving / {panel}" and collapse org/ws into a single kebab pill that expands on click. Click expansion must be keyboard operable.

omar: Impl detail: the pill expansion should be a menu button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, not just hover. That solves keyboard/AT.

leigh: Motion: subtle fade+translate for the expanded menu, 120ms. Avoid layout reflow.

a11y-bot: Reminder: truncated breadcrumb items need aria-labels with full names, and tooltip text must be accessible (use aria-describedby).

sam: History behaviour: prefer pushState for user nav, replaceState for alias normalization. Edge case: opening a panel via deep-link should push one state so back button closes panel not bounce to login. Thoughts?

omar: Suggest snapshotting scroll position for list pages on pushState so when users navigate back we restore exact scroll. We'll add scroll manager util.

infra-bot: CDN note: canonicalizing to path-based deep links is better for auth redirects. Hash anchors can be lost across server redirects. If we accept hash, stash it in query param before redirect.

leigh: Copy for migration toast (first time a user hits alias): "We've grouped Models and Deployments under Serving. Your bookmarks will keep working for 90 days. Learn more." a11y-bot: prefer active voice and include a dismiss action with aria-controls.

sam: Good. Telemetry to add: alias_redirect_hit, canonicalization_replace, breadcrumb_pill_expand, deeplink_opened. We'll gate with feature flag and rollout to 10% canary.

omar: I'll wire router middleware + scroll manager + replaceState normalizer in a feature branch. Can we review keyboard flows once it's up?

leigh: Please post a canary link when ready. Also I'll make small mocks showing pill state and aria attributes.

sam: Thanks all 1. Will follow up with a concise URL map and an a11y checklist in the PR.
